svg.title: Lagoon Formation Sequence — 20,000 BP to Present
svg.desc: Six phases of Venice Lagoon geomorphological formation. Shorelines derived from northern Adriatic hypsometric curve — % of lagoon area flooded at each sea level stand. River diversions: Tagliamento, Piave, Sile, Brenta, Adige. Data: SRTM, TINITALY (INGV), CNR-ISMAR, Lambeck et al. (2014) sea level curve.
svg.text: 20,000 BP TO PRESENT — POST-GLACIAL SEA LEVEL RISE FLOODING THE NORTHERN ADRIATIC ALLUVIAL PLAIN
RELATIVE SEA LEVEL — GULF OF VENICE (LAMBECK 2014)
ALAR 4010/8010 · Productive Landscapes of the Lagoon · Fall 2026 · University of Virginia
